sources.entry: ChiefOnboarding - Employee onboarding platform that allows you to provision user accounts and create sequences with todo items, resources, text/email/Slack messages, and more! Available as a web portal and Slack bot. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: ChiefOnboarding is a free, open-source employee onboarding platform that provisions accounts and runs onboarding sequences through a web dashboard or a Slack bot.
summary.what_it_does: It automatically provisions user accounts and triggers webhooks for new hires, with integrations listed in the documentation. It supports pre-boarding pages that start before the first day, and to-do items that track tasks and let new hires fill in forms. Resources let new hires search a knowledge base and complete courses. Sequences drip-feed items over time or based on completion of a to-do item, and badges reward progress. The README also mentions introductions, admin to-do items for colleagues, per-hire timezones, and multilingual support.
use_cases: run new hire checklists via Slack
pre-boarding welcome pages before start date
collaborate on admin tasks for a new hire
how_to_run: See the Docker deployment details on Docker Hub (referenced in the README)
Alternatively use the one-click hosting options listed: Heroku, Render, Elestio, Easypanel, ZopDay
Full setup details are in the project documentation (link not included in README text)
notable: Usable through both a web dashboard and a Slack bot, each with all features
Sequences that release items over time or after a to-do is completed
Pre-boarding pages before the new hire's start date
Per-hire timezone settings and customizable branding and email templates
Multilingual interface: English, Dutch, Portuguese, German, Turkish, French, Spanish, Japanese
caveats: Support is best-effort via GitHub issues; faster response requires a paid support package
Hosted-for-you option is a paid service
Hosting, maintaining and backing up the instance is the user's responsibility when self-hosting
keywords: automate account creation for new hires
